messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'pool-03' queue length spiked above 600 (5m avg 482 -> now 612). Autoscaler attempted 3 scale actions, all failed: quota_limit_exceeded. Throttling engaged on route /v1/generate (model=vx-2.1-hotpatch). Affected zones: us-west-2a/us-west-2b. Paging oncall.

dave oncall: on it. paging eng-runtime @bob and eng-ml @carla. any obvious recent change?

bob runtime: seeing a deployment for vx-2.1-hotpatch at 10:12 UTC pushed to 100% yesterday. Metrics show average context length per request jumped from ~800 -> ~3.1k tokens after rollout. KV cache prefill volume increased ~3.8x, causing memory pressure + increased per-request processing time. Logs:

```text
[2026-06-12T10:19:21Z] pool-03 qlen=612 inflight=114 autoscale_attempt=3 error=QuotaExceeded
[2026-06-12T10:19:22Z] model=vx-2.1-hotpatch prefill_tokens=3100 avg_latency_ms=4200
[2026-06-12T10:19:23Z] kvcache.entries_prefilled=230k memory_rss=86GB -> 94GB
```

bob runtime: autoscaler failing because provider returned per-region GPU quota 0 for new instance type (we've been trying to request p5d-24xlarge), so scaling requests are being rejected. Already raised to cloud quota team but expected ETA >= 30m.

carla ml: the hotpatch enabled aggressive prefill of full conversation context to improve next-token quality (we included an extra prefill pass for entity linking). That prefill multiplies KV writes per session; with many long-lived chats this exploded. We can rollback the prefill flag quickly if needed.

lisa infra: confirmed quota errors from cloud logs: "RequestedInstanceLimitExceeded: Cannot request more p5 instances in region". Manual launch of existing spare capacity would require owner's approval. I can re-target autoscaler to older instance family (p4d) but that takes ~6-8m to spin up and will not satisfy immediate queue pressure.

deploy-bot: Deploy vx-2.1-hotpatch (sha: a1b2c3d) rolled out at 2026-06-11T10:12:03Z -> rollout=100%. Canary phase passed. No rollout hooks triggered.

erin cs: FYI: Support ticket #5721 from AcmeCorp reports 503s for several workspace endpoints starting ~10:15. Customer-facing dashboards show API error rate spike 12% in the last 10m.

dave oncall: OK immediate priorities: 1) Reduce incoming cost per request (disable prefill / fallback model). 2) Stop growth of queue (route-level throttling + reject on heavy contexts). 3) If possible, add manual capacity to pool. Bob/Carla/Lisa — assign actions.

bob runtime: I'll flip routing to fallback variant (vx-2.1-lite) for non-enterprise routes and lower max_context for new sessions. Command to update route policy:

```bash
# temporarily route heavy requests to smaller model
redwoodctl routes set --route /v1/generate --model vx-2.1-lite --match 'context_tokens > 2000' --reason "hotpatch-prefill-surge mitigation"
```

bob runtime: also enabling a hard cutoff by token count at the gateway for now to protect pool. Will log rejected requests for post-mortem.

carla ml: I'll prepare immediate hotfix to toggle prefill=false in model config and push a canary to 10% traffic. Model config snippet:

```json
{
  "model": "vx-2.1-hotpatch",
  "features": {
    "prefill": false
  }
}
```

carla ml: note: disabling prefill reduces quality for certain entity-linking prompts, but it's acceptable as a temporary mitigation.

lisa infra: trying manual pool scale to p4d family now as emergency. If autoscaler can't reach p5 quota, we can attach warm pool nodes of p4d. Requesting infra-team approval for immediate billing bump.

dave oncall: erin, please update affected customer AcmeCorp: we are mitigating with temporary routing changes; anticipate partial restoration within 15-30m. Mark incident severity P2 for now.

erin cs: acknowledged. Posting note to ticket and sending status update: "We are mitigating increased latency and 503s by temporarily routing heavy requests to a lower-capacity model and disabling an aggressive prefill. Engineering investigating root cause."

deploy-bot: Action: route update queued (id: rq-9983). Hotfix for model config prefill=false created (pr: #2145). Canary push to 10% will start after approval.

bob runtime: route change applied for match 'context_tokens > 2000' -> ~28% of incoming traffic now routed to vx-2.1-lite. Gateway hard cutoff at 6k tokens enabled. Queue starting to reduce: qlen 612 -> 398 in 4m.

carla ml: canary prefill=false pushed to 10% at 10:27. Observing per-request processing time drop in canary workers. If metrics look good, we can ramp.

lisa infra: manual p4d nodes provisioned and attached to pool-03 (4 x p4d added). They are starting; will be ready ~10:35. Autoscaler logs still show quota rejects for p5.

dave oncall: good. monitor customer impact and aim to restore 95% of normal throughput. Keep me posted on qlen and errors. After immediate stabilization, we'll do root-cause follow-up and roll back hotpatch or change default config.

bob runtime: qlen 398 -> 210 -> 90 over 18 minutes. Error rate down from 12% -> 4%. API 5xx count trending down but still > baseline. Continuing to ramp canary. Will collect traces for slow requests.

carla ml: ramping prefill=false to 50% now. Quality SIG aware and standing by to accept tradeoffs.

erin cs: AcmeCorp notified: partial restoration observed, they'll keep monitors open and will escalate if they still see errors.

dave oncall: once stabilized, we need a short post-incident writeup: timeline, root cause (prefill flag + rollout + quota), mitigation steps (route fallback, prefill toggle, manual capacity), impact (customer 503s, internal pages), and action items (quota increase request, rollout gating for prefill, add autoscaler fallback to older instance family). Assign to eng-sre + eng-runtime + eng-ml. I'll open the incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-06-12-311. Handoff: eng-sre (owner: lisa infra) for follow-up, eng-runtime (owner: bob runtime), eng-ml (owner: carla ml). Postmortem due in 5 business days.

dave oncall: thanks team. keep channel updated if anything regresses. If qlen or 5xx increases beyond current, we'll escalate to on-call lead.

bob runtime: saving interesting logs/traces under /var/logs/incidents/INC-2026-06-12-311 and will attach to the incident doc. Key grep to find affected requests:

```bash
grep -E "prefill_tokens|vx-2.1-hotpatch" /var/log/proxy/*.log | tail -n 200
```

carla ml: note for postmortem: change control gap — the prefill toggle lacked rollout gating by per-request token distribution. Action: add preflight check in deployment pipeline to reject enabling prefill when average context tokens > 1000 in last 24h for that route.

lisa infra: I'll follow up on quota with cloud vendor and propose autoscaler fallback config that prefers available instance families before requesting new quotas. Also will keep spare warm nodes in us-west-2 for critical pools.

erin cs: I'll coordinate customer comms for any downstream escalations and save messages in the incident doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: pool-03 queue stabilized qlen=68 avg_latency=320ms; throttles removed from /v1/generate. Owners: lisa infra, bob runtime, carla ml. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-06-12-311

dave oncall: closing paging loop for now. handoff to owners for follow-up. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
